migrationOrder.goal: Complete LionWing character creation without changing 0.9 saves or budgets.
Review likely mechanical field changes and create LionWing-specific adapters.
Translate new Boons, inherent Boons, Ability words, symbols, and costs.
Port Effects, Basic Actions, combat formulas, and derived statistics into a separate LionWing rules layer.
Upgrade enemies and table automation only after the LionWing core rules are reviewed.

levels.name: Barrier
levels.text: If you Cast targeting one or more allies, you don't deal damage or Negative Effects. Instead, Reinforce them and create a ‘Barrier' between one of them and a space adjacent. Barriers are 5 + [Tier x 5] Health walls that move to match allies they were created for, and do not affect the targeting or movement of allies. After you create a Barrier it replaces all other Barriers.

levels.name: Impenetrable
levels.text: After you create a Barrier, extend it one space in both directions and give [Spirit / 2] Evasion to all allies adjacent to it.

levels.name: Block Beam
levels.text: After your Barrier would be removed or replaced for any reason, it ‘Fires' away from the character it was created for, dealing [Spirit] damage to all enemies in an infinitely long orthogonal Line.

fields.old: You may always Interact to ‘Paint' on an adjacent space in a ‘Color' of your choice. Each Color has a specific effect that triggers when you or an ally enters its space or starts their Turn in it for the first time in a Round. The Colors are as follows. ‣ Red: Strengthen yourself. ‣ Yellow: Teleport to another Colored space. ‣ Blue: Gain 2 Focus. ‣ White: Push any enemies in 3 spaces 3 spaces. ‣ Black: Pull any enemies in 5 spaces adjacent to you.

fields.old: You may always Interact with a willing character to set them as your ‘Partner'. You may only have one Partner and lose them if you end your Turn outside of adjacency. When a Partner moves willingly, their Partner may move to a space adjacent to them and gain Haste.
fields.new: You can Interact with a willing character to set them as your ‘Partner'. You may only have one Partner and lose them if you end your Turn outside of adjacency. When one Partner moves willingly, the other may move to a space adjacent to them and gain Haste.

fields.old: When a Partner Hides, or gains Focus, their partner gains the benefits in addition.
fields.new: The first time a Partner Hides, or gains Focus each Turn, their partner gains any positive Effects or Focus they gained.

fields.old: When a Partner uses a Finisher, their Partner may Daze themselves to have the Finisher Crit on rolls of 5. Using this effect makes the user lose their Partner status.
fields.new: When a Partner uses a Finisher, their Partner may Daze themselves to have the finisher crit on rolls of 5 or 6, Teleport adjacent to the target, and use a Skirmish / Cast on the target. Using this effect makes the user lose their Partner status.

fields.old: After deploying, roll one die and set it aside. These dice are your ‘Cards'. When you Breathe with three or fewer Cards, roll a new Card. When you Cast you may spend any of your Cards to roll [Mind] instead of [Spirit] and gain the Card's assigned bonus. The bonuses granted by each Card are as follows: 1: Illness: Does not deal damage. Blights the Target. While the target is Blighted, they are also Slowed. 2: Etteilla: When targeting an enemy, you restore Focus equal to the damage dealt. 3: Night: Does not deal damage. The target Disappears and becomes Invisible. 4: Protection: Does not deal damage. Reinforces the target, this Effect is not lost at the end of Turn. 5: Union: Teleport to an unoccupied space adjacent to the target and Snare them. 6: Folly: Does not deal damage. Dazes, Immobilizes, Launches, Fears, and Taunts the target.
fields.new: After deploying, roll a die and set it aside. These dice are your ‘Cards'. After you Breathe with three or fewer Cards, roll a new Card. Before you Cast, you may spend any of your Cards to roll [Mind] instead of [Spirit], have it deal no damage to allies, and gain the Card's bonus. The bonuses for each are as follows: 1: Illness: Blights and permanently Slows the Target. 2: Star: Restore Focus equal to the damage dealt. 3: Night: The target Disappears and becomes Invisible. 4: Protection: Permanently Reinforces the target. 5: Union: Snare the target, Teleport adjacent to them. 6: Folly: Dazes, Immobilizes, and Launches the target.

A Trap is a piece of Difficult Terrain that, when stepped on, forces you to Swift Cast at no Cost targeting the character on it while rolling a new Card and immediately spending it to add its effects. This removes the Trap.
fields.new: Once per Scene, after you Investigate an NPC's Attack, you can roll a Card with all of that attack's non-damage effects. At the end of the scene, you can replace a Card in your deck with that Card. You can only replace up to 3 of your Cards like this at a time, and can return your default Cards at any time.

fields.new: After your Mount attacks an enemy, you may have it Taunt them.

fields.old: Once per Scene when your Mount would take its Turn, you may have it Roar instead. When your Mount Roars, it Dazes all enemies in 3 spaces of it, pushing them 3 spaces away.
fields.new: Once per Scene for 1 AP, you may have your Mount "Roar". When it Roars, it Dazes enemies in 3 spaces of it, pushing them 2 spaces.

fields.old: Beastial Ascendant
fields.new: Bestial Ascendant

fields.old: Delayed, Versatile
fields.new: Delayed, Sustain

fields.old: Choose two non-Modifier Enemy Types. Once per Scene, when you Charge with at least 2 Tension, you may ‘Transform', pushing all enemies within 2 spaces of you 3 spaces away and restoring [Guts x 2] Health. While Transformed you can use your Enemies' Attacks, said attacks lose any additional damage from Tension. When you're reduced to 0 Health while Transformed, it ends, and you're Dazed.
fields.new: Choose two NPC Types. Once per Scene, after you Charge or Awaken this with at least 2 Tension, you may ‘Transform', pushing all enemies within 2 range 3 spaces away and restoring [Body x 2] Health. While Transformed you can use your NPCs' Attacks, said Attacks lose any additional damage from Tension. After you're reduced to 0 Health while Transformed, it ends, and you're Dazed.

fields.old: Choose one of the two Enemies you chose when gaining "Beastly". You gain that enemy's Passive while Transformed. If the Passive triggers when the user is Knocked Out, it triggers when you end your Transformation instead.
fields.new: Choose one of the two NPCs you chose when gaining "Beastly". You gain that NPC's Passive while Transformed, and use their on Deploy effects when you Transform. If the Passive triggers when the user is Knocked Out, it triggers after you end your Transformation instead.

fields.old: When you're Transformed you can use one of your enemies' Aces by spending 2 AP. Each of your Aces can only be used once per Scene.
fields.new: While you're Transformed you can use your NPCs' Actions by spending 1 AP. If you're Tier 3 or higher, you may Daze yourself and spend 2 Focus to transform as soon as you deploy regardless of Tension.

fields.old: Weapon, Body, Effects
fields.new: Weapon, Body, Revenge

fields.old: It's said that in order to effectively counter an oncoming force, one would need 5 times the force to stop it. I assure you… I have that.
fields.new: It's said that to effectively counter an incoming blow, one would need five times the force to stop it. I assure you… I have that.

fields.old: When you Skirmish you may choose to ‘Raise', targeting no characters, Reinforcing yourself, and Taunting all adjacent enemies. When you Skirmish while Reinforced you must ‘Fall', dealing double damage and losing Reinforced.
fields.new: Before you Skirmish, you may ‘Brace', making the Skirmish target no characters, Reinforcing yourself, and Taunting all adjacent enemies. If you Skirmish while Reinforced, you ‘Slam', dealing [Tension] additional damage and losing Reinforced.

fields.old: When you Fall after taking at least 5 pre mitigation damage since the end of your last Turn you target all spaces adjacent to you instead of your normal targeting and Weaken all targets.
fields.new: If you Slam after taking at least 5 damage before reductions since the end of your last Turn, you target all spaces adjacent to you instead of your normal targeting and Weaken all targets.

fields.old: You Look Like A Nail
fields.new: "You Look Like A Nail"

fields.old: When you Fall after taking at least 10 pre mitigation damage since the end of your last Turn you deal triple damage.
fields.new: If you Slam after taking at least 10 damage (before reductions) since the end of your last Turn, you deal an additional [Body] damage.

fields.old: Woah. You're bigger in person. Like. Way bigger. Oh right, the armor, right away sir!
fields.new: Woah. You're bigger in person. Like. Way bigger. Oh right, the armor. Right away sir!

fields.old: When you use a Body Finisher, you may spend 1 additional Focus to have it target each character in a 2x2 Zone adjacent to you so long as at least one of those spaces are adjacent to you.
fields.new: Before you use a Body Finisher, you may spend 1 Focus to have it target each character in a 2x2 Zone adjacent to you.

fields.old: You may take up a 2x2 section of spaces rather than one space when you Deploy, if you do so you freely move through 1x1 enemies and Terrain. Gain [Tier] Guts. When you choose your size, you must stick with it until your next Tier up.
fields.new: Gain [Body] additional maximum Health. You may take up a 2x2 section of spaces rather than one space when you Deploy. If you do so, you may freely move through 1x1 enemies and Obstacles.

fields.old: When you use a Body Finisher, you may spend 1 Focus to have it target all spaces adjacent to you, deal half damage, and have it Launch its targets.
fields.new: Before you use a Body Finisher, you may spend 1 Focus to have it target all spaces adjacent to you, deal half damage, and have it Launch its targets.

fields.old: Make way for Pantomime's blazing star!" "The killer king with the inescapable pin!" "The one, the only… Raphaël Blasé!
fields.new: Make way for Pantomime's blazing star! The killer king with the inescapable pin! The one, the only… Raphaël Blasé!

fields.old: When you Successfully Body Finisher, Snare your target, characters you have Snared also count as being Taunted by you.
fields.new: After you Body Finisher, Snare your target. Characters you have Snared also count as being Taunted by you.

fields.old: Your Skirmishes gain 1 Advantage. When you Spike a single Launched character, you may teleport to an unoccupied space adjacent to your target and change the attack you are using into a Body Finisher at no additional cost.
fields.new: Your Skirmishes gain 1 Advantage. If you would Spike a single Launched character, you may teleport to a space adjacent to your target and change the attack you are using into a Body Finisher at no Cost.

fields.old: Finishing Move [ Body Finisher Jump ]
fields.new: Finishing Move [ Body Finisher → Jump ]

fields.old: Instead → of moving with this Jump, you and a target of the Finisher Disappear. At the start of the next round or when either of you would be able to take another Action (whatever comes first) you both return to the board in the same space, Launching all other enemies in 2 spaces of you, and letting you Swiftly Body Finisher the initial target at no cost.
fields.new: Instead of moving with this Jump, you and a target of the Finisher Disappear. At the start of the next round or when either of you're able to take another Action (whatever comes first) you both return to the board in the same spaces, Launching all other enemies in 2 range, and letting you Swiftly Body Finisher the initial target at no cost.

fields.old: Guardian Angel
fields.new: Guard Caller

fields.old: I don't exactly know where it came from. I just know it protects me when I need it. It's given me this one chance to change things for the better.
fields.new: Tybalt's Faerie is a strange thing, stays hidden whenever it can. Its ability to shield and mend is invaluable for a guard, but he worries something's wrong with it, with every beast they fend off it stares at the body longer, and when tensions rise he swears he hears sobbing.

fields.old: Upon Deployment, your character is split into two separate spaces: the ‘Guardian' space and the ‘Defendant' space. When you move, you move both the Guardian and Defendant separately. When you Cast, it must draw its range from the Defendant space. When you Skirmish, it must draw its range from the Guardian space. When the Defendant receives damage, it is dealt as a Wound instead, or 2 Wounds if the damage dealt was more than their Guts.
fields.new: You can Block when other characters are attacked, granting that character any Armor you would gain and preventing any forced movement they'd receive. When you would Block for an ally without a ‘Guardian' marker, first create one in a space within [Spirit] range. Unless the Guardian is adjacent to the attacker or the target when you Block, the Block is canceled. If you move while you have a Guardian you may move them the same distance.

fields.old: When you successfully Cast, the target becomes Weak. When you successfully Skirmish a Weak character, you Launch the target(s).
fields.new: Allies who start their Turn adjacent to or in the Guardian's space are Reinforced, enemies who do the same are Marked.

fields.old: Your Health and Guts now scale off your Spirit instead of your Body. If an ally is Attacked within 4 spaces of the Guardian, you may spend 1 Focus to have the Guardian teleport adjacent to them and become the target of the Attack.
fields.new: Your Blocks for allies have their focus cost reduced to 1 and gives [spirit] armor instead of [body].

fields.old: Mushir Ahmed has a reputation for his displays of confidence. Most famously is his armor, it covers his legs and arms but leaves his chest bare. It baffles advisors and opponents alike..
fields.new: Mushir Ahmed has a reputation for his displays of confidence. Most famous is his armor: It covers his legs and arms, but leaves his chest bare. It baffles advisors and opponents alike.

fields.old: Gain [Body / 2] Armor.
fields.new: Gain [Body/2] Armor.

fields.old: His physique spoke to me. It said, "Get the fuck out of my way.
fields.new: His physique spoke to me. It said, ‘Get the fuck out of my way.'

fields.old: When you Jump, you may move [Body] spaces instead of [Talent], deal 30 damage to Terrain you pass through, and move any number of characters you passed through or moved into adjacency with to a space adjacent to you.
fields.new: Before you Jump, you may move [Body] spaces instead of [Talent], may deal 30 damage to any Obstacles you move adjacent to, and move any number of characters you passed through or moved into adjacency with to a space adjacent to you.

fields.old: Once per Round, when you move through or move into adjacency with characters using "Wild Charge", you may deal [Body / 2] damage to them and Launch one of them.
fields.new: Once per Round, after you move through characters using "Wild Charge", you may deal [Body / 2] damage to them and Launch one of them.

fields.old: Hard Turn
fields.new: "Eat Dirt!"

fields.old: When you Jump, you may reduce the number of spaces you move by 2 to make it so you can move without moving in a Line.
fields.new: After you Launch an adjacent character without Attacking, you may ‘Throw' them, moving them 5 spaces in any direction. If they end their movement adjacent to another character or Obstacle, deal [Body] damage to both and remove Launched from them.

fields.old: You enter all combat Scenes with a ‘Suit' adjacent to you. This is a 2x2 piece of terrain with 15 Health and [Tier] Armor. By Interacting with it, you put the Suit on. This removes the Terrain, grants you [Tier] Armor, and makes your character 2x2 in size. You may use Interact again to leave the Suit, losing these benefits and placing the terrain adjacent to you in sufficient empty spaces.
fields.new: Once per scene, when you attack an enemy you may Summon your ‘Mech' to assist you, making the attack deal [Tier] additional damage and placing it adjacent to the target, with it pushing any characters in its space adjacent to it or as close as possible. The Mech is a 2x2 NPC with no Type, 15 Health, and [Tier/2] Armor that cannot take Turns. By Interacting with it, you ‘Pilot' it. This removes the NPC, grants you [Tier/2] Armor, and makes your character 2x2 in size. You may use Interact again to leave, losing these benefits and placing the Obstacle adjacent to you in sufficient empty spaces.

fields.old: The Suit is now a Summoned non- Modifier Enemy of your choice with a Tier equal to yours, so long as you don't have it on. It is still 2x2 in size and counts as both Terrain and an Enemy, regardless of the enemy chosen (if this summon would have more than 15 health raise it to be equal to the summon's health). When your Summon takes its Turn, you may choose to Skirmish a character adjacent to it in place of one of its Attacks.
fields.new: The Mech can now take Turns and is changed to a non- Modifier NPC of your choice with a Tier equal to yours and a minimum of [Tier/2] armor. While your Summon takes its Turn, you may Skirmish a character adjacent to it (regardless of range) in place of one of its Attacks.

fields.old: You may Interact with the Suit after Deployment at no Cost. Even when you are in the Suit, it may still take Turns as a Summon, sharing your space and moving you when it moves. While you are in the Suit, the Summon is Dazed.
fields.new: You may start scenes Piloting. Even while you are in the Suit, it may still take Turns as a Summon, sharing your space and moving you when it moves. While you are in the Suit, the Summon is Dazed.

fields.old: Revenge, Body, Tanking
fields.new: Tanking, Body

fields.old: You now use ‘Tenacity' instead of Focus or AP, gaining and losing it rather than the former. You start each Round of combat with 1 Tenacity + [Body / 2], and you must spend it in place of Focus and AP. You can't gain Tenacity using Breathe or Charge. You can't use Cast or Spirit Finishers.
fields.new: You now use ‘Tenacity' instead of Focus or AP, spending it in place of both. You start each Round of combat with 2 Tenacity + [Body / 2]. You can't gain Tenacity from anything other than this Technique. You can't use Cast or Spirit Finishers.

fields.old: When you are targeted by an Attack, you gain 1 Tenacity.
fields.new: After you're the target of an Attack, gain 1 Tenacity. When you would gain Focus, you reduce the cost of your first Finisher that Round by the same amount (this includes the initial AP cost as well as any additional cost added that would normally be paid with Focus).

fields.old: When you Breathe or Charge, you may Taunt a number of characters equal to the Focus you would have gained within 4 range. When rolling for Charge, you may Roll Body instead of Spirit.
fields.new: Once per Scene, after you target an adjacent enemy, you may spend 2 Tenacity to ‘Silence' them. Silenced characters can only move or Attack on their Turn, and their Attacks cannot apply or trigger any feature or effect other than damage. Enemies you Silence remain Silenced until they end their Turn outside of adjacency with you, or until the end of the Round (whatever happens first).

fields.old: Talent, Tanking, Support
fields.new: Tanking, Spirit, Attacks

fields.old: Two swordsmen lock blades silhouetted by moonlight, the impact reverberating throughout the streets, blowing out a nearby streetlamp. One survivor lives on, regretting every second of it.
fields.new: Two swordsmen lock blades, silhouetted by moonlight. The impact reverberates throughout the streets, blowing out a nearby streetlamp. One survivor lives on, regretting every second of it.

fields.old: When you perform a successful Clash, you gain 1 Focus and can move [Tier] spaces.
fields.new: After you perform a successful Clash, you gain 1 Focus and can move [Tier] spaces.

fields.old: You may Clash with Attacks that target allies within [Talent] spaces. When you Clash, you may Teleport to a space adjacent to the character who initiated the attack.
fields.new: You may Clash with Attacks that target allies within [Spirit] spaces. Before you Clash, you may Teleport to a space adjacent to the character who initiated the attack.

fields.old: Gain 3 Advantage in Clashes.
fields.new: Gain 2 Advantage in Clashes. Your Spirit counts as being 2 higher while in Clashes

fields.old: Runic Retribution
fields.new: Mollycoddler

fields.old: Tanking, Mind, Support
fields.new: Revenge, Casts, Tanking

fields.old: To truly love something you must let it kill you.
fields.new: Y'know, you should be thanking me. True love isn't just given, it's PROVEN through trials of character and moments of doubt. And this, this is the greatest trial you could face! You'll never get another chance like it~

fields.old: When an ally is hit by an Attack you may Swiftly Cast the attacker regardless of range at no Cost.
fields.new: When an ally is hit by an Attack, you may spend 1 Focus to Swiftly Cast, targeting the attacker regardless of range at no AP Cost (this cannot trigger Lash or have you Cast targeting yourself).

fields.old: When you would Investigate you may offer a ‘Deal' to an ally in its range instead. If they take this deal they may Swiftly take any 1 Cost Action at the cost of being Marked. If they don't take the deal you restore any AP spent.
fields.new: When an ally is damaged, you may take [Tier] damage to reduce the amount they took by [Tier]. After you trigger this because an ally was attacked, you may Fear the Attacker.

fields.old: When an ally takes the deal from "Loving Rite" they may also ‘Double Down', Marking an enemy of their choice and making both Marks applied unable to be removed for the remainder of the Scene. When an ally you've Marked takes any Action they may choose to move one space towards any Marked enemy.
fields.new: When you trigger "Loving Rite" and no other allies are Marked by you, you may Mark them. When you trigger "Lash" with an ally you've Marked, you may use a Finisher instead of Cast. Joel's Notes: Using Summons If you're creating a character who can use Summons or NPC actions it's important to familiarize yourself with the Narrator-side NPC rules on page 108.

old.name: Servant's Call
old.flavor: Tybalt's Fairy is a strange thing, it stays hidden whenever it can. Its ability to shield and mend is invaluable for an imperial guard, but he worries something's wrong with it, with every beast they fend off it stares at the body longer, and when tensions rise he hears sobbing.

levels.name: A Subordinate's Honor
levels.text: When you Cast targeting an empty space, you may spend 1 Focus for each empty space and create a Tier 1 Guardian, Slime, or Paladin Summon there. It can only do 1 damage when it attacks and has half its normal Health. You can only have [Tier] Summons from this Technique at a time.

levels.name: Hero's Hymn
levels.text: When you Charge you may Teleport one of your Summons into a space adjacent to you. Until the start of your next turn, that Summon must be targeted instead of you if you're targeted by an attack.

levels.name: Supreme Servant
levels.text: Once per Scene when you use a Spirit Finisher targeting one empty space, you may spend 3 Focus and create a Tank Summon of your choice with a Tier equal to yours. That enemy is a named character who has a Rank 3 Bond with you.

fields.old: Body, Tanking, Movement
fields.new: Tanking, Body, Movement

fields.old: When you Block, you may spend 2 Focus to gain [Tier] additional Armor, and retain the Armor until your guard is broken, or you start your Turn.
fields.new: Before you Block, you may spend 1 Focus to gain [Tier / 2] additional Armor, and retain the Armor until you take another reaction, or you start your Turn.

fields.old: When you Block, place a ‘Shield Marker' in a space adjacent to you until you stop blocking. The Shield Marker moves to match your movement. When your movement would move your Shield Marker into an opponent's space, you may remove the Marker to deal [Body / 2] damage to them and push them 2 spaces.
fields.new: After you Block, place a ‘Shield Marker' in a space adjacent to you until you create another one. The Shield Marker moves to match your movement. If your movement would move your Shield Marker into an opponent's space, you may remove the Marker to deal [Body] damage to them and push them 2 spaces.

fields.old: While you have a Shield Marker, indicate a 3×3 Zone centered on it. If an enemy attacks you while inside that Zone, you count as having [Tier] additional Armor for the Attack.
fields.new: While you have a Shield Marker, indicate a 3×3 Zone centered on it. If an attack would resolve against you while the attacker is inside that Zone, they're Weakened for the duration of the Attack.

fields.old: So long as you haven't moved during your turn. The spaces diagonally connected to your count as being adjacent when it would benefit you.
fields.new: So long as you haven't moved during your Turn, the spaces diagonally surrounding you count as being adjacent when it would benefit you.

fields.old: Begin tracking ‘Vigilance', a 4 Segment Clock that's filled at the start of every Scene. You may empty one Segment of this Clock when performing a Punish to have it not cost AP. When you Charge you refill the Vigilance Clock.
fields.new: Begin tracking ‘Vigilance', a 4 Segment Clock that's filled at the start of every Scene. You may empty one Segment of this Clock when using Punish to have it not cost Focus. After you Charge, you refill the Vigilance Clock.

fields.old: When you Investigate you may place up to 4 ‘Spotlights' in any unoccupied space on the board. A Spotlight is a unique piece of Difficult Terrain that only affects enemies. When a character enters a Spotlight you may teleport to an unoccupied adjacent space and Punish them as if they left adjacency with you.
fields.new: After you Investigate, you may place up to 4 ‘Spotlights' in unoccupied spaces on the board. A Spotlight is a unique piece of Difficult Terrain that only affects enemies. When an enemy enters a Spotlight, you may teleport to an adjacent space and Punish them as if they left adjacency with you.

fields.old: Tanking, Body, Support
fields.new: Tanking, Body, Sustain

fields.old: You may Block Attacks that target allies within [Body] spaces, when you do so you Teleport to a space adjacent to the ally being targeted and become the target instead.
fields.new: You may Block Attacks that target allies within [Body] spaces. When you do so, you Teleport to a space adjacent to the target and become the target instead.

fields.old: The first Block you use each Round has no Focus cost and gives you [Tier] Armor until the start of your next Turn, if you're Blocking for your allies.
fields.new: The first Block you use each Round has no Focus cost and gives you [Tier] Armor after the Attack resolves until the start of your next Turn, if you're Blocking for your allies.

fields.old: When you start a source of movement by moving out of adjacency with an ally, they may move to a space adjacent to your new location and Reinforce.
fields.new: After you start movement by moving out of adjacency with an ally, they may move to a space adjacent to your new location and Reinforce.

fields.old: The Students of Mardrus were widely renowned in their day, creating the doctoring profession as we know it. Shame their achievements are overshadowed by the human cost of their good work.
fields.new: The Students of Mardrus were widely renowned in their day, creating the doctoring profession as we know it. Such a shame their achievements were overshadowed by the human cost of their work.

fields.old: You no longer use Focus. When you would spend, or lose your Focus, you use 2 Health for each point of Focus instead, when you gain Focus gain an equal amount of Health instead. When you successfully Attack a character with two or more different Effects, you begin Regenerating.
fields.new: You no longer use Focus. Any increases to your starting Focus increases your max Health instead. If you would spend, or lose Focus, use 2 Health per Focus instead, if you would gain Focus gain an equal amount of Health instead, any of this healing that would be prevented reduces the Focus cost of your next Finisher by the same amount. After you Attack a character with two or more different Effects, begin Regenerating.

fields.old: When you successfully Attack, you may take 5 damage to roll a D6. Apply an Effect to your target based on the result of the roll. When you have [Guts] or less Health, you may use this without taking damage. 1-2: Blight 3-4: Daze. 5-6: Immobilize.
fields.new: After you Attack, you may take 5 damage to roll a D6. Apply an Effect to your target based on the result of the roll. If you have 5 or less Health, you may use this without taking damage. 1-2: Blight 3-4: Daze. 5-6: Immobilize.

fields.old: Once per Scene, when you use a Spirit / Body Finisher you may trigger Overexert twice and change its targeting to all enemies with more Health than you.
fields.new: Once per Scene, after you use a Spirit / Body Finisher, you may trigger "Overexert" twice and change the Finisher's targeting to all enemies with more Health than you.

fields.old: Your successful Skirmishes and Talent Finishers Blight the target.
fields.new: Your successful Skirmishes and Talent Finishers Blight the target(s).

fields.old: Rupture [ Skirmish Breathe ]
fields.new: Rupture [ Skirmish → Breathe ]

fields.old: If the Skirmish → targeted a character with Blight, make a Talent Roll and trigger the effect of Blight [Hits] times.
fields.new: If the Skirmish's target was Blighted, roll Talent and trigger the effect of Blight [Hits] times.

fields.old: When resolving an action targeting a piece of Terrain, you may destroy it to create a 3×3 Zone of ‘Gas' centered on its space that disappears at the start of your next Turn. When an enemy enters Gas they are Weakened. Allies in the Gas gain 3 Evasion when they're targeted by attacks coming from outside the Gas.
fields.new: Your Improvises have their Cost set to 1 and can create an Obstacle up to 4 spaces away. When resolving an action targeting an Obstacle, you may destroy it to create a 3×3 Zone of ‘Gas' centered on its space that disappears at the start of your next Turn. When an enemy enters Gas, they are Weakened. Allies in the Gas gain 3 Evasion when they're the target of an Attack coming from outside the Gas.

fields.old: When you Weaken a character you may ask the Narrator what it's current Health is, if it's at or below [Mind] that character is Knocked Out and you gain 2 Focus.
fields.new: After you Weaken a character, you may ask the Narrator what its current Health is. If its at or below [Mind], that character is Knocked Out and you gain 2 Focus.

fields.old: When you create a Gas Zone Weaken and deal [Mind] damage to all enemies in the spaces it covers. When you defeat an enemy with "Experimental Mixture" create a 3x3 Gas Zone centered on them.
fields.new: After you create a Gas Zone, deal [Mind] damage to all enemies in the spaces it covers. After you Knock Out an enemy with "Experimental Mixture", create a 3x3 Gas Zone centered on them.

fields.old: Your Successful Skirmishes with 1 target Snare the target. At the end of your Turn, you can move all characters you've Snared up to 5 spaces. You do not need to pull characters you've Snared when you move.
fields.new: Your Successful Skirmishes with 1 target Snare the target. At the end of your Turn, you can move all characters you've Snared up to 5 spaces. You do not need to pull characters you've Snared after you move.

fields.old: Your Skirmishes gain 1 Advantage. When "Wrap" moves two or more characters adjacent, they receive [Talent] damage.
fields.new: Your Skirmishes gain 1 Advantage. When "Wrap" moves a character into adjacency with other characters, they each receive [Talent/2] damage.

fields.new: Movement, Talent, Effects

fields.old: It's an easy job, in-and-out, no need for worries, no need for anyone to get hurt. Bump into Āl-Amir just after sunset and slip your hand into his pouch. Be sure to apologize and offer something, historically he'll refuse.
fields.new: It's an easy job. In and out. Bump into Āl-Amir just after sunset and slip your hand into his pouch. Be sure to apologize when he takes notice, and offer something by way of apology. Be polite, and he might not notice a missing satchel bag, or a knife in the back.

fields.old: When you leave adjacency with an enemy on your Turn (once per character per Turn), you may end your movement to do one of the following, that you haven't used on your Turn. ‣ Disarm: Weaken them. ‣ Trip: Immobilize them. ‣ Steal: Gain 2 Focus.
fields.new: Once per character per turn, after you leave adjacency with an enemy on your Turn, you may end your movement to do one of the following that you haven't already used this Turn. ‣ Disarm: Weaken them. ‣ Trip: Slow them. ‣ Steal: Gain 2 Focus.

fields.old: When you inflict certain Negative Effects on an enemy, you may gain its positive version. The Effects this applies to are as follows. ‣ Blight: Regenerate. ‣ Immobilize / Snare: Hasten. ‣ Shred: Reinforce. ‣ Weaken: Strengthen.
fields.new: After you inflict certain Negative Effects on an enemy, you may gain its positive version. The Effects this applies to are as follows. ‣ Blight: Regenerate. ‣ Slow / Snare: Hasten. ‣ Shred: Reinforce. ‣ Weaken: Strengthen.

fields.old: Thief In The Night
fields.new: Rob Them Blind

fields.old: After you Hide, you can use "Fast Hands" without ending your movement and lets you use options you've already used on your Turn. This lasts until the end of the Turn.
fields.new: If you used Hide on your Turn, you can use "Fast Hands" without ending your movement. Once per Scene, if you leave all spaces adjacent to the same character, you may Blight, Slow, Shed, Weaken, and deal [Tension] damage to them.

fields.old: You lost the moment you touched the ground.
fields.new: I don't think you understand the gravity of that move. You lost the moment you touched the ground.

fields.old: Tectonic Shift
fields.new: Stone Soldiers

fields.old: When you move Terrain you didn't create or another character, you create a piece of Terrain with 10 Health and 0 Armor in the space it left.
fields.new: As you Cast or use a Spirit Finisher, you may move an Obstacle adjacent to you into a space adjacent to your target. Doing so destroys the Obstacle after the Attack. If there are no Obstacles within 3 spaces of you when you deploy you may create up to 2 of them with 10 health adjacent to you.

fields.old: Earthen Shards
fields.new: Tectonic Shift

fields.old: When you destroy or move a piece of terrain, you may deal [Tier] damage to all enemies adjacent to its new position. Each enemy can only be damaged by this effect once per Turn.
fields.new: After you move another character or an Obstacle you didn't create, you create an Obstacle with 10 Health in the space it left. Using Stone soldiers gives the triggering attack 3 Advantage.

fields.old: Stone Soldiers
fields.new: Earthen Shards

fields.old: When you Cast or use a Spirit Finisher you may move a piece of terrain adjacent to you into a space adjacent to your target, doing so gives the Attack 3 Advantage and destroys the terrain after the Attack resolves.
fields.new: After you destroy or move an Obstacle, you may deal [Spirit] damage to an enemy adjacent to its new or previous position. Each enemy can only be damaged by this effect once per Turn.

fields.old: True freedom doesn't exist in this world. Even the wind cannot blow on forever.
fields.new: Feel my bite, my roar, and my racing heart.

fields.old: When you Cast targeting an unoccupied space or Jump, you may place a ‘Typhoon' in the targeted space / space you left, and all spaces adjacent to it, replacing all other Typhoons you've created. old.text: When you're working against more enemies than you have allies, you gain 2 Advantage on all Rolls.

new.name: Outgunned
new.text: When you're working against more enemies than you have allies, you gain 2 Advantage on all Rolls.

old.name: The One Thing You Can Rely On
old.en: The One Thing You Can Rely On
old.text: You may form Bonds with weapons as if they were characters, when you do so they're Rank 1 and Partners. Weapons made via an Ability all count as the same weapon.

new.name: The One Thing You Can Rely On
new.en: The One Thing You Can Rely On
new.text: You may form Bonds with weapons as if they're characters. When you do so they're Rank 1 and Partners. Weapons made via an Ability all count as the same weapon.

description.old: Wise for your years, no matter how many, a towering beacon of experience and strength. Though maybe this isn't The Mentor's story to use this.
description.new: Wise for your years, no matter how many, a towering beacon of experience and strength. Though maybe this isn't The Mentor's story to use this.

old.name: A Power That Must Never Be Used Again
old.en: A Power That Must Never Be Used Again
old.text: Once per Chapter, your Ability can instantly kill any unnamed NPC standing in front of you regardless of context. If you ever use the effect of this Boon, you lose two Bond Ranks with a character of your choice. If you lose all of your Bonds, you lose control of your character permanently.

new.name: A Power That Must Never Be Used Again
new.en: A Power That Must Never Be Used Again
new.text: Once per Chapter, your Ability can instantly kill any unnamed NPC standing in front of you regardless of context. If you ever use the effect of this Boon, you lose two Bond Ranks with a character of your choice. If you lose all of your Bonds, you lose control of your character permanently.

old.name: An Organized Style
old.text: When you use your Ability in a way you've never used it before, you can give that specific usage a name to gain 3 Advantage.

new.name: An Organized Style
new.text: When you use your Ability in a way you've never used it before, you can give that specific usage a name to gain 3 Advantage.

new.name: Casual Excellence
new.text: Choose two of your Skills or a Skill and Ability. When you would Roll using one of these features to gain Advantage, you may roll a single die instead, getting a Failure on a roll of 1, a Minimum Success on a 2-5, and an Extreme Success on a 6. A Narrator may make you roll 2 dice and take the lower if the challenge would be exceptionally high.

old.name: Old, Calloused Hand
old.text: Write two "Calluses", a negative event that you've dealt with before, leaving you stronger. When you're presented with a Threat related to your Callus, you may lose 1 Stress.

new.name: Old, Calloused Hand
new.text: Write two ‘Calluses', negative events that you've dealt with before, leaving you stronger. When you're presented with a Threat related to your Callus, you may lose 1 Stress.

old.name: Past Your Prime
old.text: You may only choose this when creating your character. You start with 12 Character Ranks for Skills and your Ability rather than 8, and must spend at least 8 on Skills. Gain one less Character Rank every Tier.

old.name: Perspective Of A Teacher
old.text: Your Bonds with Students always count as being 2 Ranks Higher when used in a Roll (this can surpass the Rank 3 maximum). When you only have one Student and you use Influence with them present, they gain an Influence.

new.name: Perspective Of A Teacher
new.text: Your Bonds with Students always count as being 1 Rank higher when used in a Roll (this can surpass the Rank 3 maximum). When you only have one Student and you use Influence with them present for the first time in a Scene, they gain an Influence.

description.old: Bright-eyed greenhorns looking to make up for the experience they lack and make a name for themselves. The Apprentice starts small, but holds big ambitions.
description.new: Bright-eyed greenhorns looking to make up for the experience they lack and make a name for themselves. The Apprentice starts small, but holds big ambitions.

old.name: A Step Behind, But Still Running
old.en: A Step Behind, But Still Running
old.text: When you Awaken in an unstructured Scene you gain 3 Advantage on the next roll you make.

new.name: A Step Behind, But Still Running
new.en: A Step Behind, But Still Running
new.text: When you Awaken in an unstructured Scene, you gain 3 Advantage on the next roll you make. Gain 2 Character Ranks that can only be used to Awaken.

old.name: Amazing Potential
old.text: You may only choose this when creating your character. You start with 6 Character Ranks for Skills and your Ability rather than 8, but you only need to spend 2 on Skills. Gain one extra Character Ranks every Tier.

new.name: Amazing Potential
new.text: When you Roll for a Test with one or fewer sources of Advantage, roll an additional die. This is your "Star Die". If your main roll is a Failure, but your Die is a 5, it becomes a Minimum Success at the cost of 1 Stress. If it's a 6 the roll becomes an Extreme Success.

old.name: Land Among The Stars
old.text: When an opponent rolls more dice than you in an Opposed Roll, you gain 1 Influence.

old.name: Never Give Up!
old.text: When you fail a Challenge Roll with 1 or more Stress, you may immediately retry the Roll with 1 Advantage for every point of Stress you have.

new.name: Never Give Up!
new.text: Once per Chapter, when you fail a Roll with immediate consequences, you may hold it back, drawing a 2 segment Clock instead. This Clock fills a segment when you Roll against something other than that Threat, or at the Narrator's discretion. The Threat resumes when the Clock fills, and you take 1 Stress (this is not self-inflicted Stress).

new.name: Order And Out
new.text: While you're following any kind of order given by one of your Bonds, they may "Help" you, even if they're not in the same Scene.

old.name: Plenty To Learn
old.text: When you go All Out, you may flash back to a Scene where you were taught something relevant to your current Roll . Doing so grants you 4 Advantage.

new.name: Plenty To Learn
new.text: Once per Scene, If a player you Study uses Influence in that Scene, gain 1 Influence.

new.name: Still Getting Used To It
new.text: When you use your Ability to gain Advantage in a roll, roll a die. If it's even gain [Tier] additional Advantage from it. If it's odd, gain no Advantage from it. Gain 3 Character Ranks to spend on your Ability. When you would Awaken a Boon you may remove this one instead, and gain another 2 Character Ranks to spend on your Ability.

description.old: Doomed from the beginning, a being of ill fortune, granted power they never asked for. What is the power? How can they get rid of it? The Accursed rarely knows.
description.new: Doomed from the beginning, a being of ill fortune, granted power they never asked for. What is the power? How can they get rid of it? The Accursed rarely knows.

old.name: Sacrifice
old.text: You may use this Boon after any Roll to make it a Extreme Success by sacrificing one of the following (It can't be restored, only replaced). ‣ Your eye. ‣ Your arm. ‣ Your leg. ‣ Your tongue. ‣ Your life.

new.name: Sacrifice
new.text: You may use this Boon after any Roll to make it an Extreme Success by sacrificing one of the following (It can't be restored, only replaced). ‣ Your eye. ‣ Your arm. ‣ Your leg. ‣ Your tongue. ‣ Your life.

new.name: Self Destructive Strength
new.text: When you use an Ability to gain Advantage on a Roll, but don't use either a Bond or a Skill, you may take 1 Stress to "Overload" your Ability and gain double the Advantage from it.

old.name: Tainted Body
old.text: One or more of your limbs or eyes are wrapped in bandages or otherwise concealed from other people. Once per Series, when you spend Influence, you may reveal this body part to gain 3 + your Tier Character Ranks to spend on gaining and/or Ranking up a new Ability.

new.name: Tainted Body
new.text: One or more of your limbs or eyes are concealed from other people. Once per Series, when you spend Influence, you may reveal this part to gain 3 + [Tier] Character Ranks to spend on your Ability.

new.name: The Voice
new.text: Your Ability is sentient and speaks to you. It also counts as a Bond and can be used in rolls (unless you're using it as an Ability). When you only use your Ability in a roll you may ask the Narrator if it's compliant in the action you're taking. If they are, gain 2 Advantage, if they aren't, take 2 Disadvantage.

old.name: Turning Over A New Leaf
old.text: When a problem occurs that could be easily solved using one of your Ability, you may lose 2 Stress and choose not to use your Ability instead.

old.name: Uncontrollable Power
old.text: Your Ability is now formatted as "You [Verb] [Noun] When You [Condition]". Meaning, their effects are always applied when the condition is fulfilled. Gain 4 Character Ranks that can be spent on your Ability.

new.name: Uncontrollable Power
new.text: Your Ability is now "You [Verb] [Noun] When You [Condition]", meaning it's always applied while the condition is fulfilled (or just always if there's no condition). When you expand your Ability choose if those new words are your "default". If so they can trigger your Ability. Gain 3 Character Ranks that can be spent on your Ability.

old.name: Volatile Blood
old.text: You do not need to keep any of your original words when using your Ability.

new.name: Volatile Blood
new.text: Your Ability ignores the "keeps one of the words contained in the original" restriction when swapping out its original words with new ones. Gain 3 Character Ranks that can be spent on your Ability.

description.old: Living in near-edenic plenty, a person granted fortune beyond imagination. Some combination of pride and ignorance is almost necessary for The Blessed.
description.new: Living in near-edenic plenty, a person granted fortune beyond imagination. Some combination of pride and ignorance is almost necessary for The Blessed.

old.name: A Web Of Connections
old.text: When you use Influence, you can identify an unnamed NPC in the Scene. You gain 2 Advantage on Rolls where that NPC is relevant.

new.name: A Web Of Connections
new.text: When you use Influence, you can identify an unnamed NPC in the Scene. You gain 2 Advantage on Rolls where that NPC is relevant.

new.name: Beck And Call
new.text: Gain a Rank [Tier/2] "Servant" Bond with an unnamed NPC you've met or one of your creation. Once per Chapter, you can call them into any non-combat Scene at will, and if they cannot show up; the Narrator must give you 1 Influence.

old.name: Convenient Transport
old.text: You always have access to some sort of all-terrain vehicle or mount that can carry up to 8 people.

old.name: Do You Know Who I Am?
old.en: Do You Know Who I Am?
old.text: When you dramatically introduce yourself around unnamed characters, you may use this Boon to prompt them to: gasp, become interested in you, or make fun of you (Narrator's choice). When you get a reaction you haven't before gain an Influence.

new.name: Sick Ride
new.text: You have a 1-2 seating ground or water vehicle that you can create or call to you by taking 1 Stress or spending 1 Influence. When you do, choose a willing character to drive and answer the 3 following questions. The driver gets Advantage equal to the number of "yes" answers on all rolls that could use the vehicle for the duration of the scene. ‣ Are you in a large open area. ‣ Does the driver have experience with it. ‣ Is it the first time you used this in this chapter.

old.name: Social Setup
old.text: Once per Chapter, you can spend 1 Influence to claim you have connections in the place you're in or relating to what you're doing. When you do this, Roll Mind with Advantage equal to your Tier and set all hits aside. Any time you're in a Scene with an unnamed character, you may claim that that person is the one you mentioned with this Boon and gain Advantage on all rolls relating to them equal to the Hits you set aside.

new.name: Social Setup
new.text: Once per Chapter, you can spend 1 Influence to claim you have connections in the place you're in or relating to what you're doing. When you do this, Roll Mind with Advantage equal to your Tier and set all Hits aside. Any time you're in a Scene with an unnamed character, you may claim that that person is part of this connection and gain Advantage on all rolls relating to them equal to the Hits you set aside.

old.name: Trust Fund
old.text: You have 10 ‘Funding Tokens', when you make a Roll you may spend any number of Funding Tokens to explain how you use your wealth to help you and gain equal Advantage. Gain 5 more Funding Tokens when you Tier up.

new.name: Trust Fund
new.text: You have 10 ‘Funding Tokens'. When you make a Roll, you may spend any number of Funding Tokens to explain how you use your wealth to help you, gaining equal Advantage on the roll. Gain 5 more Funding Tokens when you Tier up.

description.old: One of the little people in someone else's story, living a life with little personal image. Though it's hard to say how many of The Quiet would like a story of their own.
description.new: Modest and unassuming people, with a life on the fringes, not concerned with image. Though it's hard to say how many of The Quiet would like a story of their own.

new.name: Eagle Eyed
new.text: Once per Chapter, when you speak to a character you were not with the Scene before, you may ask the Narrator one of these questions. ‣ Where did they come from. ‣ Were / Are they being followed.

old.name: Gearhead
old.text: You can now create ‘Gadgets' by spending Character Ranks. They are treated as Abilities for their creation, costing, Ranking, and usage in Rolls. Unlike Abilities, Gadgets are physical and can be given to, and used by other characters in Rolls, others gain one less Advantage than what you would gain. Your Gadgets can be permanently destroyed through the Risks you receive, but also refunding you any Character Ranks you spent on them. Gain 3 Character Ranks to spend on Gadgets.

new.name: Gearhead
new.text: You can make ‘Gadgets', using Character Ranks. They're treated as Abilities for their creation and usage in Rolls. Unlike Abilities, Gadgets are physical objects that can be given to, and used by other characters, though others can only gain up to 2 Advantage from using them. Your Gadgets can be permanently destroyed through the Risks you receive or by doing so yourself. Doing either refunds you any Character Ranks you spent on them. Gain 3 Character Ranks to spend on Gadgets.

old.name: Knacks And Hobbies
old.text: You gain 3 Advantage on all rolls that don't oppose or relate to another character.

new.name: Knacks And Hobbies
new.text: You gain 3 Advantage on all rolls that don't oppose or relate to another character.

old.name: Reversal Of Fortune
old.text: When you successfully respond to a Threat coming from another character with a Roll and get at least 1 Crit, you may reverse the situation. When you do so you levy the Threat you were responding to against them, the narrator must either have them receive its effects or give you 2 Influence.

new.name: Right Place, Right Time
new.text: Once per Chapter, when an ally is in a different Scene and you are not occupied, you may appear in that Scene. If said ally was making a Roll, they may go All Out once at no cost.

old.name: Technobabble
old.text: You may use Examine with machines and supernatural objects as if they were characters, with you triggering the Crit and gaining the bonus instead of them.

new.name: Technobabble
new.text: Once per Chapter, when you see a supernatural item, you may ask the Narrator one of the following questions. Once in that Scene you can go All Out on a Roll relating to it at no cost. ‣ What does it usually do. ‣ How could it be disabled. ‣ Could I recreate its effects.

old.name: The Sneaky Superposition
old.text: At any time when your exact position is unclear, you may gain 1 Stress to appear somewhere else within reason.

old.name: The Talent
old.text: When you Awaken a Skill in the middle of a Challenge Roll, you gain 3 Advantage.

new.name: The Talent
new.text: Your once per Chapter Boons are now twice per Chapter.

description.old: A person who must make themselves known, who fears a decline in image more than their death. Who wouldn't agree with The Confident when your life has eyes on it.
description.new: A person who must make themselves known, who fears a decline in image more than their death. Who wouldn't agree with The Confident when your life has eyes on it.

old.name: And I'll Only Use One Hand…
old.en: And I'll Only Use One Hand…
old.text: Once per Chapter when you take an Opposed Roll with someone else, you may give them a handicap. This gives them 2 Advantage and gives you 1 Influence.

old.name: Chatty
old.text: When you perform an Opposed Roll, you can begin talking, be it monologuing, quipping, taunting or ranting, gaining 2 Advantage plus any Bond ranks you have with your opponent. If you fail this roll, your character receives 1 Stress.

new.name: Chatty
new.text: When you perform an Opposed Roll, you can begin talking, be it monologuing, quipping, taunting or ranting, gaining Advantage equal to your Bond ranks with your opponent. If you fail this roll, the opponent deals 1 additional Stress to you.

new.name: Do You Know Who I Am?
new.en: Do You Know Who I Am?
new.text: When you dramatically introduce yourself around unnamed characters, you may use this Boon to prompt them to: gasp, become interested in you, or make fun of you (Narrator's choice). When you get a reaction you haven't before, gain an Influence.

old.name: Perspective Of A Lancer
old.text: When you create a Bond or Rank Up a Bond, you may assign that character you're Bonded with as your ‘Lancer' . Your Lancer is always tagged as a Rival, even if they've already reached their max Tags, and you gain double the normal Advantage when using their Bond in a Challenge Roll. When you don't have a Lancer, you can make Rank 2 Quick Bonds outside Intermissions, but doing so makes them your Lancer.

new.name: Perspective Of A Lancer
new.text: Your Bonds with Rivals always count as being 1 Rank higher when used in a Roll (this can surpass the Rank 3 maximum). When you only have one Rival and you use Influence with them present for the first time in a Scene, they gain an Influence.

old.name: Spite
old.text: When you lose, either in the narrative or in an Opposed Roll , to a character you're Bonded with you may assign them as the target of your Spite. When you use that Bond to gain Advantage in any sort of competition with the subject of this Bond you may also Crit on rolls of 5, if the roll is a Extreme Success that character is no longer the target of your Spite.

new.name: Spite
new.text: When you lose, either in the narrative or in an Opposed Roll, to a character you're Bonded with you may assign them as the target of your ‘Spite'. When you use that Bond to gain Advantage in any sort of competition, you may also Crit on rolls of 5. If the roll is an Extreme Success, that character is no longer the target of your Spite.

old.name: Spotlight
old.text: So long as you're in a Tense Scene your allies may treat the Tension as being 2 lower.

new.name: You're Strong…
new.text: When you lose to an Antagonist, either in the narrative or in an Opposed Roll, you may "put them over", showing how badly you lost and stating that they're your superior. Doing this lets you and any allies in the same scene from an Rival Bond with the Antagonist or upgrade an existing bond with them by one Rank.
